focus_areas: Geometric alignment of the reflection relative to the duck's body
Structural correctness and boundary definition of the curled tail feathers
Texture consistency of the iridescent head feathers
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the reflection in the water aligns geometrically with the duck's posture and if the water texture around the body shows realistic displacement rather than static pattern repetition. Specifically check if the reflected head corresponds to the actual head position.
image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) floating on green water. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with an iridescent green head, white neck ring, chestnut breast, and grey body. It has a yellow-orange bill and is casting a reflection on the water surface.
